description: This file defines an Android AccessibilityService subclass that handles key events to control display magnification. It includes methods for reacting to volume key presses to adjust magnification scale, overseeing service connection setup, and monitoring magnification changes.

classes.name: MagnificationService
classes.description: An AccessibilityService that modifies display magnification based on volume key presses, with callbacks for magnification change events.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events, but is empty in this implementation.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Handles service interruption, no actions taken.

methods.name: onKeyEvent
methods.description: Processes key events; specifically intercepts volume up/down keys to control magnification.

methods.name: handleVolumeKey
methods.description: Adjusts the magnification scale proportionally when volume keys are pressed.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes service info and registers a magnification change listener upon connection.
